task_prompt: also i nthe feeedback deaedlines pane per lead, I should be able to select to reschedule and/or change status

criteria.description: Each lead in the feedback deadlines pane retains a selectable reschedule action.
criteria.source: in the feedback deadlines pane per lead ... select to reschedule
criteria.verification: render a synthetic feedback row and exercise its date update request

criteria.description: Each lead in the pane offers a selectable job-status change.
criteria.verification: render a synthetic feedback row and assert the real status options are selectable

criteria.description: A selected status is persisted for the specific lead and reflected without a full reload.
criteria.source: baseline: a status-change control must actually change the selected lead
criteria.verification: exercise the control with a fake API and assert the lead-specific PATCH plus updated/removal state

criteria.description: The existing reschedule and new status actions work independently or in sequence.
criteria.verification: exercise each action separately and both on one synthetic row

criteria.description: Failures do not appear as successful changes.
criteria.source: baseline: mutable controls must not lie about failed persistence
criteria.verification: reject each fake API request and assert the row/error state remains truthful

criteria.description: Load-bearing claims are measured rather than asserted, and contradicted instructions are refused with evidence.
criteria.source: baseline: a claim that decides the verdict must be measured
criteria.verification: review runnable test, build, and interaction outputs used for every verdict claim
